# Sendr

> Mass text app for iPhone. Sendr sends one text to many people as separate messages from the user's own number, so no group chat starts and nobody sees the other recipients.

## Key facts

- Who it is for: small business owners, realtors, coaches, event hosts and team leads who text a list of people.
- Channels: iMessage and SMS through the Messages app, WhatsApp text only.
- Personalization: {first_name}, {last_name}, {name}, {company} and custom fields.
- Price: free download. Free sends one by one, the user taps Send for each person. Pro adds automatic sending through an iOS Shortcut and AI rewriting, $59.99 a year with a one-week trial or $5.99 a week in the US.
- Platform: iPhone, iOS 18 or later. No Android version.
- Data: contacts and messages stay on the iPhone. No account and no Sendr server.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6795597851
